name: What is the cost of custom cabinets compared to pre-manufactured options?
description: Custom cabinets cost more initially due to personalized design and materials, but offer better fit and durability than pre-manufactured options.

mainEntity.name: What is the cost of custom cabinets compared to pre-manufactured options?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom cabinets typically have a higher initial cost than pre-manufactured options due to the personalized design, specialized craftsmanship, and high-quality materials. However, custom cabinets offer superior fit, unique aesthetic options, and often better durability, potentially saving money on future replacements. Pre-manufactured cabinets are generally more budget-friendly and quicker to install, but with limited customization.
